conviction_note: The release adds a first FY8/27 guide. Fast Retailing's last three full-year prints rose 5.75%, 6.09% and 6.65% on initial guides that were at or above consensus, and the stock has derated 23% from its July peak while sell-side targets were raised. Against that, the July print sold off with FY27 'guidance risk' flagged and there is a weak-yen margin squeeze on Japan. So a modest upward lean (p_up 57) on a large scale (5.5%). The findings sum (+1.6) is about twice the scaled +0.77 because each finding is sized alone, while the scaled number carries all the sign uncertainty of a guide nobody has seen.
bar: FY8/26 operating profit: company guide ¥730.0bn (raised 2026-07-09, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9983&b=n202607091061) vs IFIS consensus ¥727.3bn from 11 analysts, unchanged over 4 weeks (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9983). The bar that matters, the FY8/27 initial guide, has no sourced consensus. The only proxy is IFIS 12-month-forward EPS of ¥1,855.6 against the company's FY8/26 EPS of ¥1,629.5, about +14% (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTarget?bcode=9983), so the guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via the baseline). 信用倍率 2.74, modest margin-long tilt. priced_lean_pct is −0.62 (runup −0.40, margin −0.22). There is no option skew in Japan. Rated by 11 analysts (7 strong-buy), average target ¥86,445, 15.6% above spot. The 10/9 next session is the monthly SQ day before a three-day weekend, and FR is the largest Nikkei 225 weight, so index mechanics add noise at the open.

findings.finding: On each of the last three full-year prints, Fast Retailing's first guide for the new year came in at or above consensus and the stock rose the next session: Oct-2023 +5.75%, Oct-2024 +6.09%, Oct-2025 +6.65%. In Oct-2025 the FY8/26 net guide of ¥435.0bn beat the QUICK consensus of ¥424.7bn. The company then raised FY8/26 OP from ¥610bn to ¥730bn through the year, so its initial guides are conservative but not below the street.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Full-year (new-guide) prints: +5.75 (2023-10-13), +6.09 (2024-10-11), +6.65 (2025-10-10), computed from Yahoo daily closes. Mid-year raises have been sold: the 2026-07-09 raise was followed by −3.59% (fisco: 出尽くし, FY27 guidance risk).
findings.why_not_priced: The FY8/27 number does not exist until 15:30 today, and there is no sourced FY27 consensus to price it against. If the market were positioned for a repeat of the pattern, the stock would not be 14% below its July close while sell-side targets went up (JPM ¥82k→¥94k on 8/20, MS ¥86k→¥87k on 9/4). Sized well below the historical +6% because the pattern is public and the July sell-off shows the street worries about FY27.
findings.independence: Monex 2023-10-19 says FR's FY8/24 guide was 'コンセンサス予想を上回る強気の見通し' (https://media.monex.co.jp/articles/-/23025). The FY8/26 guide path is in the FY25 results deck (https://www.fastretailing.com/jp/ir/library/pdf/20251009_results.pdf).

findings.finding: The stock fell from ¥86,930 (2026-07-06) to ¥66,760 (2026-09-14), about −23%, with the Nikkei roughly flat. Over the same weeks brokers raised targets (JPM ¥94k, MS ¥87k, Nikko trimmed to ¥88k) and the IFIS FY8/26 consensus did not move (¥780.8bn pre-tax, unchanged vs 1 and 4 weeks ago). The price has reset below where the published numbers sit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 23% derating, the 2026-04 print (+11.99) and 2026-01 print (+10.67) came off rising, not falling, prices, so there is no direct precedent. The 20-day run-up of +7.9% has already recovered about a third of the fall.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the +12% bounce since 9/14 is the market already unwinding some of it. What would show it fully priced is the stock back near the ¥80k+ pre-Q3 range. At ¥74.7k it is not.
findings.independence: MS target raise 2026-09-04 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9983&b=n202609041066). IFIS consensus is flat over 4 weeks (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9983). Price path from Yahoo (baseline tape).

findings.finding: Fast Retailing beat its July guide at the last full-year print: the FY8/25 results deck says business profit came in 'above the forecast announced in July'. This year the July guide implies Q4 (Jun-Aug) OP of only about ¥115.6bn (¥730bn less ¥614.4bn for 9M), roughly +2% year on year, and IFIS sits slightly below the guide at ¥727.3bn. A small FY8/26 beat on the reported period is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 FY26 beat (Q3 OP about ¥40bn above consensus per fisco) sold off −3.59%. Reported-period beats have not been what moves this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: anyone can compute the low Q4 hurdle. That is why it is sized small. It sits inside guidance.
findings.independence: The Q3 guide and 9M OP come from a different document (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9983&b=n202607091061).

findings.finding: Q4 domestic Uniqlo same-store sales (incl. EC) were June −14.1%, July +4.3% and August −1.3%. The company had already guided Q4 Japan to a slight revenue decline and a double-digit profit decline from weak-yen procurement costs, knowing June when it did.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August miss (−1.3%) was sold on 2026-09-03 (大幅続落), so it is in the price.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The monthly series is public, and Q4 Japan was guided down in July (https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-07-09/fast-retailing-2026-3q-report/). Filed at zero for completeness.

findings.finding: September domestic Uniqlo same-store sales, the first month of FY8/27, rose +10.8% (customers −0.5%, ticket +11.3%) on cooler weather and strong autumn/winter product, the first double-digit month since May. That supports a confident tone on the FY27 guide and on Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose about +4.1% on 2026-10-05, the first session after this release (fisco: 大幅反発).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock already reacted +4% on it. What is left is whether management carries the September strength into the FY27 guide and Q1 commentary.
findings.independence: Fisco's 10/5 note says other apparel specialists showed the same September pattern (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9983&b=n202610050647). Same underlying release.

findings.finding: There is a weak-yen margin headwind for FY8/27 Japan. The company attributed Q4 FY26's double-digit Japan profit decline to the yen, the FY25 deck cited weaker-yen procurement forward rates raising the cost ratio, and USD/JPY has run at about ¥157-162 through Jun-Sep 2026. Fisco wrote after Q3 that FY27 guidance risk was rising, which could make the FY27 guide on the Japan segment cautious.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-07-10 session (−3.59%) is the only observed reaction to the FY27 guidance-risk framing.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced in the 23% derating. It is an inference from FX plus company commentary, not a company number. Overseas translation runs the other way at group level (Uniqlo International is the larger profit pool), so net group impact is small.
findings.independence: Q4 Japan profit decline attributed to weak yen (https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-07-09/fast-retailing-2026-3q-report/). FX path from Yahoo JPY=X monthly bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X?range=6mo&interval=1mo).

findings.finding: Shareholder returns: at the last full-year print FR raised the FY8/25 dividend from the ¥480 July plan to ¥500 and guided FY8/26 at ¥520, later lifted to the current ¥640 forecast. A further final-dividend bump and a FY8/27 dividend guide above ¥640 are the likely pattern.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Dividend raises have come bundled with the FY prints that rose about +6%. They cannot be separated from the guide effect.
findings.why_not_priced: The yield is 0.86% and the register is Yanai- and institution-heavy, so a dividend raise matters little. Sized small. FR does not do buybacks as a pattern, and no split is announced or sourced.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none pre-filed. FY8/26 actuals vs ¥730bn OP guide, with IFIS at ¥727.3bn, so a small beat is likely. Returns: dividend raise likely (¥640 forecast, raised at the last FY print). Buyback or split: no evidence. New-year guide: the FY8/27 initial guide is the main item, against an unsourced street of about +14% forward EPS. FR's last three initial guides were at or above consensus. Quarter vs own 進捗率: 9M OP of ¥614.4bn is 84.2% of the guide, and the implied Q4 is about +2% YoY, a low hurdle FR cleared last year.

baseline_tension: The findings lean positive against a mildly negative priced lean (−0.62, from the run-up and margin longs). The +7.9% 20-day run-up is a rebound inside a 23% drawdown rather than a crowded run-in. The strongest negative the release could carry is a cautious FY8/27 guide on weak-yen Japan margins, after a +29% OP year; I looked for it and it is in the findings at −0.5.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 goes toward 50) was already applied in the draft, where the Q4 monthly finding sits at 0.0. Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives) does not apply to a positive-leaning set, and the strongest negative was searched for and filed. Open question 4 (run-in as a short signal) was not used.
